text: {"lessons":["Judge positions by the current outlook and risk, not just whether they are below my average cost; repeated loss-driven exits can lock in losses without improving decisions.","Avoid frequent, reactive trading: selling and rebuying Stock B at changing prices and trimming Stock C left me exposed to timing mistakes and trading churn.","Before adding to a position, especially after a sharp price move, check that it fits my diversification and long-term plan rather than chasing recent performance."]}
